import math
import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from solution import build_station_view


class BuildStationViewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_filter_sort_convert_round_and_ignore_extras(self):
        stations = [
            {"id": "b", "name": "beta", "current_c": 0, "forecast_c": [10.04, -40], "extra": {"x": 1}},
            {"id": "z", "name": "ALPHA", "current_c": 20.25, "forecast_c": []},
            {"id": "a", "name": "alpha", "current_c": 10, "forecast_c": [0, 100]},
        ]
        original = deepcopy(stations)
        self.assertEqual(
            build_station_view(stations, "ALP", "f"),
            [
                {"id": "a", "name": "alpha", "current": 50.0, "forecast": [32.0, 212.0], "unit": "F"},
                {"id": "z", "name": "ALPHA", "current": 68.5, "forecast": [], "unit": "F"},
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(stations, original)

    def test_empty_query_and_celsius_output_are_independent(self):
        stations = [{"id": "x", "name": "Straße", "current_c": 1.26, "forecast_c": [2.34]}]
        result = build_station_view(stations, "STRASSE", "c")
        self.assertEqual(result, [{"id": "x", "name": "Straße", "current": 1.3, "forecast": [2.3], "unit": "C"}])
        result[0]["forecast"].append(99)
        result[0]["name"] = "changed"
        self.assertEqual(stations[0]["forecast_c"], [2.34])
        self.assertEqual(stations[0]["name"], "Straße")
        self.assertEqual(build_station_view([], ""), [])

    def test_type_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_station_view((), "")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_station_view([], None)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_station_view([], "", 1)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_station_view([1], "")
        for field, value in (("id", 1), ("name", None), ("current_c", True), ("forecast_c", (1,))):
            station = {"id": "x", "name": "X", "current_c": 1, "forecast_c": []}
            station[field] = value
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                build_station_view([station], "")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_station_view([{"id": "x", "name": "X", "current_c": 1, "forecast_c": [False]}], "")

    def test_value_errors(self):
        base = {"id": "x", "name": "X", "current_c": 1, "forecast_c": []}
        for key in base:
            malformed = dict(base)
            del malformed[key]
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build_station_view([malformed], "")
        for field, value in (("id", ""), ("name", ""), ("current_c", math.inf), ("current_c", math.nan)):
            malformed = dict(base)
            malformed[field] = value
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build_station_view([malformed], "")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_station_view([base, dict(base)], "")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_station_view([{**base, "forecast_c": [1, -math.inf]}], "")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_station_view([], "", "K")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
